sections.title: سبق 23 — متن (217)

paras.text: One of the fruits of faith is that the servant becomes content with the pleasure of Allah Almighty in every condition and becomes one who is patient in afflictions instead of complaining. However, this does not negate the immediate and involuntary effect of some shock; rather it negates that lasting effect from which complaints arise on the tongue and a trace of ill-thought about the Lord arises in the heart.

sections.theory:
One of the fruits of faith is that the servant becomes content with the pleasure of Allah Almighty in every condition and becomes one who is patient in afflictions instead of complaining. However, this does not negate the immediate and involuntary effect of some shock; rather it negates that lasting effect from which complaints arise on the tongue and a trace of ill-thought about the Lord arises in the heart.

The believing servant's reliance is not on his own effort, intelligence, planning and the means he has arranged, but on Allah Almighty. Tawakkul is that permissible means be adopted for permissible matters, but reliance concerning the result be placed only on the Causer of causes.
